text:
maria: heads-up — after the kernel-selector tweak merged last night, were seeing a tail-latency regression on H100 when batches exceed ~12k tokens. KV cache fragmentation looks correlated.
raj: can you drop the profiler output and the exact job id?
maria: job 2026-03-17-18:23-prod-sample. profiler excerpt below (p95 spikes when batch_tokens > 12k):
```
model: rwd-13b-fp16
gpu: H100-80GB
batch_tokens: 12500
p50: 42ms  p95: 610ms  p99: 1.05s
kv_frag_rate: 28% (steady -> spikes during long generations)
kernel_seq: matmul_fast -> matmul_v2 -> matmul_fallback (fallback freq x3)
cuda_stream_stalls: +18%
notes: increased kernel-switch overhead + KV cache rehashing causing extra mem copies
```
tim: A10 & A100 traces look fine — A100 tolerates 16k+ tokens without fallback. H100 seems sensitive to the kernel affinity scoreboard when mixed packrat shapes land.
sarah: this smells like continuous batching heuristic edge-case: when we allow very large token budgets the scheduler aggregates heterogeneous shapes and triggers kernel fallbacks. KV cache fragmentation amplifies it.
maria: i ran a local repro with loadgen and saw the same: when we let `max_tokens_per_batch` float, H100 path picks the slower kernel for ~15% of slices and latency jumps.
oliver: short-term mitigation: apply a softcap per-cardclass that prevents the scheduler from forming >12k tokens on H100. keep other cards unchanged.
raj: agree. we should also add a kernel-switch counter to tracing to validate fix.
sarah: proposal (config patch):
```
# per-cardclass soft limits (tokens)
max_tokens_per_batch:
  H100: 12288
  A100: 16384
  A10: 10240
  L4: 6144
  T4: 4096
```
Rationale: H100 fallback cost + KV frag -> tighter cap. A100 can keep higher headroom. A10 conservative due to memory pack ratio.
maria: perf experiment plan: 1) deploy softcap to canary region for 2 hours, 2) run the same synthetic load and prod shadow traffic, 3) compare p95/p99 and kernel-switch counts.
raj: add dashboard panels: kernel_switch_rate, kv_frag_pct, batch_tokens_hist, p95_latency_by_cardclass. link: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/slot-affinity (placeholder).
oliver: infra-bot will push the canary config after review. tagging @infra-bot to run the deploy job.
infra-bot: deploy request received: canary config push queued (job id: deploy-1719009990-softcap). ETA ~10m.
maria: thanks. if this stabilizes H100 tail we can codify per-cardclass defaults and add an autotuner that suggests these caps based on recent kernel-switch and kv_frag metrics.
raj: follow-ups: (1) script to sweep max_tokens_per_batch and record kernel-switch delta, (2) add tracing instrumentation, (3) document in eng-runtime runbook.
sarah: i'll own the experiments. maria, can you draft the runbook snippet with command lines to reproduce?
maria: on it — initial gist in thread in 30m. :thumbsup:
